import importlib,json,sys,time,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import polars as pl
from polars.testing import assert_frame_equal
import ibex_pyarrow
from ibex_polars import IbexEngine
sys.path.insert(0,'/home/brj/code/polars-benchmark')
r=Path('/home/brj/code/polars-benchmark/data/tables/scale-10.0')
query=importlib.import_module('queries.polars.q18').q(**{p.stem:pl.scan_parquet(p) for p in r.glob('*.parquet')})
route=sys.argv[1]
engine=IbexEngine().prepare(query) if route=='ibex' else 'streaming'
start=time.perf_counter_ns()
result=query.collect(engine=engine)
elapsed=(time.perf_counter_ns()-start)/1e6
reference=query.collect(engine='in-memory')
assert_frame_equal(result,reference,rel_tol=1e-10,abs_tol=1e-8)
print(json.dumps({'ms':elapsed,'shape':result.shape,'schema':str(result.schema),'bridge_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(ibex_pyarrow.__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()}))
